seo.title: GetUsRanked — Privacy Policy
seo.description: How GetUsRanked collects, uses, and protects your personal information. Read our full privacy policy.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
bullets: **Contact information:** Name, email address, company name, and website URL submitted through our contact form.
**Business information:** Description of your business provided in the audit request form.
**Communication data:** Any information you include in emails or messages sent to us.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to:
bullets: Respond to your inquiries and audit requests
Provide, maintain, and improve our SEO services

sections.title: 3. Cookies and Tracking
sections.body: Our website may use the following tracking technologies:
bullets: **Google Analytics:** To understand how visitors interact with our website (page views, session duration, traffic sources). This data is anonymized and used solely for improving our website.
**Google Search Console:** To monitor our website's search performance. This does not track individual visitors.
sections.afterBullets: We do not use cookies for advertising or sell any tracking data to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sections.body: We may use third-party services to help us operate our business, including hosting providers, email services, and analytics tools. These services may have access to your information only to perform tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes described in this policy. Contact form submissions are retained for up to 24 months after the last interaction. Client data is retained for the duration of the engagement and 12 months after termination, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
bullets: Access the personal information we hold about you
Request deletion of your personal information
sections.afterBullets: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at hello@getusranked.com.

sections.title: 7. Data Security
sections.body: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contactSection.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, contact us at
